title: How Can I Keep From Singing
lyrics: And though the st[A]orms may come,
[A]How can I keep from singing Y[E]our praise?
[A]How can I keep from shouting Y[E]our Name?
I know I am [D]loved by the [F#m]King
For I know my Savior lives.
And I will walk with You,
And sing the songs You give.
I can sing in the troubled times,
I can sing when I lose my step
I can sing, 'cause You pick me up,
I can sing, 'cause You hear me, Lord,
When I call to You in prayer.
I can sing with my last breath,
That I'll sing with the angels
And the saints around the throne!
How can I keep from singing Your praise?
How can I ever say enough?
How can I keep from shouting Your Name?
I know I am loved by the King,
I am loved by the King,
I am loved by the King,
And it makes my heart want to sing!
artist: Chris Tomlin, Ed Cash, Matt Redman
